description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity capital and value creation for small to mid-market companies in Romania and CEE. The private equity market in Romania is relatively small and marked by inconsistent deal activity, with significant declines in growth segment investments over the past five years. Morphosis aims to provide value creation to its portfolio companies by leading buy & build strategy, operational improvements, building management capabilities, enhancing marketing capabilities and operational scaling. A material share of investees is expected to be women-led or owned, thereby addressing gender divides. Beyond the project, IFCs support to the Fund Manager to become a fully scaled Fund Manager will signal the commercial viability of the PE model in Romania and CEE. Additionally, the Fund aligns with IFCs strategy to deepen the regional private equity market, demonstrating the region's ability to support funds in Romania and strengthen regional private equity market integration.

The proposed transaction is an equity investment of up to EUR 15 million to Morphosis Capital Fund II Cooperatief U.A. (Morphosis II or the Fund), a closed-end private equity fund targeting Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) as well as lower mid-market companies in Romania and select Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) countries, including Poland, Croatia, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Slovenia. The Fund will be domiciled in the Netherlands with a target size of EUR 110 million
